maria: Quick sync — proposing a burn-in matrix for the upcoming driver+firmware roll to reduce GPU crashes/Xid frequency.

maria: TL;DR: run small smoke pool (48 GPUs) -> 72h burn-in on expanded pool (200 GPUs) -> region-staggered rollout with rollback gates. Need owners + maintenance windows.

aj: what's the expected extra cost for the 72h burn? region constraints? :money_with_wings: 

maria: estimate ~4 GPU-days per instance * 200 = 800 GPU-hours. With burst pricing that's ~$12k top-end for the test window. We'll cap us-west burst at 20%.

devin: metrics we should track: `gpu.xid.count`, `gpu.ecc.corrected.count`, `gpu.ecc.uncorrected.count`, `gpu.reset.count`, and `gpu.health.score` (rolling 1h/24h). Alert if xid rate > 1 per GPU-hour or uncorrected ECC > 0.

leo: drain/replace plan?

maria: Runbook snippet:
```
1. mark node unschedulable: `rgctl node cordon <node>`
2. drain workloads: `rgctl drain <node> --grace 300`
3. run smoke job: `tools/gpu-smoke --model 2B --seq 1024 --duration 2h`
4. collect logs: `/var/log/nvidia/gpu_err.log` + telemetry snapshot
5. if persistent XID or uncorrected ECC -> tag for RMA and replace
```

sre-oncall: can we add a synthetic workload that also stresses PCIe/IO? Xid sometimes correlates with link retrains.

maria: yes — will include `--pci-stress` flag and a small network shuffle. Also enabling verbose driver logs for the canary pool: `NV_LOG_LEVEL=debug`.

infra-bot: scheduled job created: `driver-fw-burnin-1951234567` (canary pool 48 GPUs) — start 1951242000

aj: keep an eye on regional capacity. If us-east is tight, shift some burn to eu-west. Cost and capacity team OK?

devin: telemetry flags set requested: `gpu.errors.xid.count`, `gpu.ecc.corrected.count`, `gpu.ecc.uncorrected.count`, `gpu.reset.count`, `gpu.mem.errors`.

maria: thanks — I've updated the PR with the matrix and runbook. Owners: maria (coord), leo (maintenance windows), devin (telemetry), aj (capacity/cost). Please ack.

leo: ack. booking maintenance March 23-25 for us-west staggered windows.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started on pool `burnin-canary-48` :rocket:

sre-oncall: will monitor dashboards and post alerts in this thread. If we see XID spike > 50% above baseline in 1h, we'll auto-stop rollout.

aj: noted. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all. will follow up with post-run summary and any RMA list. :eyes:
